title: Experts disagree on scripts/check-plugin-skills.mjs
context:
Chief architect: No disagreement: these are three test cases for one checker. The full negative list is the lead because it covers every way a label or key can be wrong; the argument-hint fixture (named in the issue's acceptance criteria) and the all-six-keys positive case stay alongside it.

Target: scripts/check-plugin-skills.mjs
- qa-engineer: Given a fixture SKILL.md with an argument-hint key, when pnpm run plugin:validate runs, then it exits non-zero and the message names the file and the key; proof: unit test with a temp fixture dir.
- qa-engineer: Negative cases each need their own fixture and failing assertion: description with no prefix, prefix in wrong case or missing trailing space, 'Claude Code: ' paired with the chat compatibility value (and the reverse), compatibility text off by one character, unparseable or missing front matter, and a bin/ folder at the plugin root.
- qa-engineer: Positive boundary: a skill using all six allowed keys (name, description, license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools) passes, so the checker is proven not to over-block.
